messages:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: consolidating action items from the regional failover. We saw three repeating failure modes: intermittent route announcements, stale snapshot metadata, and ambiguous on-call handoffs during game day. I want concise owners and dates.

kevin: I'll take the routing automation guardrails. Deliverable: controller changes to avoid mass withdraws + a canary plan. Target: PR by 2026-03-04, canary next week.

sasha: I'll rewrite the restore runbook to be stepwise, include exact commands and expected outputs. Also adding a triage flow for partial restores. Draft by 2026-03-02.

anil: I'll implement a lightweight snapshot-verifier that does checksum + a small restore verify in staging. Cadence: nightly for EU snapshots. ETA: 10 business days.

maria: Good. Add alerts for verifier failures so we detect regressions early.

kevin: Will add route-convergence metric and an SLO entry. Suggest target: 3 minutes for warm-standby switch.

ops-runbooks: Runbook snippet to include in drafts:
- Preconditions: latest snapshot present, route table healthy, ops oncall notified.
- Step A: Quiesce writes: ``curl -X POST https://api/reconfig/maintenance``
- Step B: Restore: ``./restore --id $SNAP --region eu --verify``
- Step C: Health checks: /healthz, sample inference, token validation.
- Post-check: ensure route convergence < 3m; if > 3m, rollback routes.

maria: Scheduling a short DR dry-run to validate changes. Proposed: Wed 2026-03-11 09:00 PT. Please hold slot and flag conflicts now.

kevin: +1

sasha: +1, will have runbook ready for pre-read.

anil: +1, snapshot verifier in staging by then.

maria: Milestones recap:
- Routing guardrails: kevin  target 2026-03-04
- Restore runbook draft: sasha target 2026-03-02
- Snapshot verifier: anil staging by 2026-03-08
- DR readiness dashboard: kevin+anil baseline by 2026-03-10

kevin: Also will draft a one-page "game-day checklist" to capture quick lessons after the dry-run.

sasha: Adding a "cache warm-up" step to runbook so partial restores don't serve stale model shards.

anil: I'll add a Grafana panel: last successful restore, verification pass rate, route convergence latency.

maria: I'll open a GH project with these items and assign owners + milestones. Posting link here when ready. If anything slips, update thread with new ETA. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder set: DR dry-run on 2026-03-11 09:00 PT in #incidents.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Keeping these small, measurable items should cut recurrence. :rocket:
